tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gying lnga gza' gdong gi gtor chog rje bla mas mdzad pa bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' sdod gying lnga gza' gdong la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ dpal gyi 'phrin las sngon du 'gro bas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ bh+rūm̐ oṃ ā hūm̐ oṃ mahā ba liṃ ta pū dzā te dzā+o hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod rol pa'i gzhir/ ra tsa tri hriḥshu rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su dbang chen thugs kyi sprul pa srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/ 'od kyi mi bo che dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon 'od kyi zhags pa thogs pa/ sku la seng ge'i slog pa gsol zhing / dbu la ji dar dkar po bcings pa/ nam mkha' 'ja' yi ske rags can/ lcags kyi sder mo rnon pos dgra snying 'byin pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i seng ge dkar po rngams sgra sgrogs pa la chibs pa/ shar du tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas zangs kyi gri ring dang / g.yon zhags pa dgra la 'debs la/ sku la dar dkar gyi ral khu gsol zhing / dbu la dung gi cod paṇa bcings pa/ rta dkar po ngang ring la chibs pa/ lhor dam can rdo rje legs pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bse'i rdo rje dang / g.yon tsit+ta dmar po thogs pa/ za 'og sngo khra'i ber gsol zhing / dbu la bse men gyi 'gying thod bcings pa/ rta kham pa lag dkar la chibs pa/ nub tu bdud po ri nag spungs pa mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing dang / g.yon zhags pa nag po 'debs pa sku la lcags kyi zhun khrab gsol zhing / dbu la bdud zhwa nag po gsol ba/ bdud rta nag po la zhon pa/ byang du srog bdag yaṃ shud dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas zangs kyi gri ring dang / g.yon zhags pa dmar po dgra la 'debs pa/

bse khrab dang bse rmog gsol ba/ bse'i rwa skyes kham pa la chibs pa/ lnga ka rngams zhing khros la drag cing rtsub pa'i rnam pa can/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu mang po 'phros pas/ pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams nas srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/ rgyal yul nam mkha' chad chod nas/ tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ nub phyogs pha waṃ lung bu'i mkhar nang nas/ dam can rdo rje legs pa/ bdud yul kha rag mgo dgu nas/ bdud po ri nag spungs pa/ btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas/ btsan 'gong yaṃ shud dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig yud tsam la e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ ra tsa tri hri shu sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas dam la bzhag rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mthar se gol gtog cing / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ra tsa srog la hrī/ a shug+me tri srog la dzaḥ tsa pa la a shug dzaḥ tri li dzaḥ badz+ra sa du hrī/ dun dun shu la gri wa i daṃ ba liṃ grih+na sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan tu ya the baṃ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ bhuñja tha dzi gha tha pi pa tha ma ti pra ma tha ma ma sarba kar+tha ya sad su khaṃ bi shud+dhe sa ha mi ka bhawan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum dang / ra tsa tri hri shu mahā sarba pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la khā his sman raka phul/ dbang drag dkyil 'khor spyi yi bka' bstod ni/ /srog la dbang bsgyur gying chen lnga rnams kyang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed cing / /zas su dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs rnams za/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i/ /dregs pa mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /zhes pas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol lo/

/yang sngar ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi mdun du rgya mtsho chen po rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus me dpung 'bar zhing sprin dang rlung nag bu yug 'tshub pa/ thog dang ser ba drag tu 'bab cing / 'brug dang glog dmar 'khyug pa'i sgra sgrog cing / gnam sa cha lang sdeb pa lta bu'i klong dkyil du ra la tsa sha rnams las 'od 'phros yongs su gyur pa las/ khro rgyal pad+ma he ru ka'i thugs kyi sprul pa gza' rgod drag po rwa hu la/ sku mdog dud kha srin po khros pa lta bu'i mgo dgu pa/ phyag g.yas kyis skyin thang gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo nam mkhar 'phyar nas dgra bo'i yul du 'phen cing / phyag g.yon chu srin gyi zhags pas dam nyams 'ching zhing za ba/ lus po thams cad mig gis gang ba/ lte ba man chad dug sbrul nag po'i gzugs kyis rgya mtsho'i gting nas dkrug pa/ de'i shar du zor srin dkar mo stag gi gdong can/ lhor baṃ srin ser mo dred kyi gdong can/ nub tu kong srin dmar mo ba lang gi gdong can/ byang du 'brog srin ljang khu chu srin gyi gdong can/ bzhi ka'ang srin mo khros pa'i rnam pa can/ g.yas zor ba dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ skad cig nyid la dgra bo'i yul khams thal bar rlog par byed pa/ gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis lho nub mtshams kyi srin yul lang ka pu ri'i grong khyer nas dregs pa gza' gdong lcam dral lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ ra hu la sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas dam la bzhag a kha kha khā hi khā hi ra hu la ma ra tsa sha ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta grih+na sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu ya the baṃ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ bhuñca tha dzi gha tha pi pa tha ma ti pra ma tha ma ma sarba kar+thā ya sad su khaṃ bi shud+dhe sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

lan gsum dang / ra hu la sa pā ri wā ra mahā sarba pañca a mṛ khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā his sman raka phul/ phyogs bzhi bar snang nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /dam bca' bka' bstod gza' gdong lcam dral yang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bo'i lo tog snar ma gsol/ /dgra bgegs yul khams thal bar rlog byed pa'i/ /gza' gdong dregs pa can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /zhes pas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bar byed na/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la shar gyi g.yas su srog bdag g.yon du tshangs pa/ lhor dam can/ nub tu bdud/ byang du btsan/ nub tu gza' mchog phyogs bzhir gdong ma bzhi rnams bskyed/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ 'di rnams slob dpon chen po nyid kyis dpal gyi lhag sdud kyi tshul du zhar la mchod pa tsam gsung / drag sngags kyi bdag po lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsa nas sgos su mchod pa'i tshul dang / las sbyor sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung sgros las ji ltar byung ba ltar/ yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis srung ma mchod pa'i cha rkyen du sbyar ba 'dis kyang bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las myur du 'grub par gyur cig/ //gying lnga'i gtor ma ni/ rin po che'i snod dung dbus su gru bzhi mkhar thab ba gam dang bcas pa'i steng du bshos bu gru gsum chung ba gcig 'jog de'i shar lho nub gsum du bshos bu gru bzhi/ byang du gru gsum rnams dkar dmar dang / khyad par ra'i khrag gis brgyan pa bsham/ gza'i gtor ma rin po che'i bshos bu gsum gnyis man gru bzhi/ sum cha yan gru gsum g.yas su bcus pa/ phyogs bzhir gru gsum g.yas bcus re rnams ra rog po'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa bsham/

mchod pa'i dus zla ba ngo re gsum gsum la/ ma grub na nya'i srod la mchod/ ces gsungs/ phan yon ni/ gying lnga dang / de byas khyi ltar rting la 'brang / /gang bcol nyan zhing las rnams sgrub/ /ma bskul bdag la 'tshe ba'i dgra/ /gang yin myur du cham la 'bebs/ /zhes dang / gza' mchod pas/ de byas gza' rgod pha ltar skyob/ /gdong mos ma ltar skyob par byed/ /sde brgyad bu ltar las rnams sgrub/ /ces pa rnams bai ro'i gsung ngo / /kha cig 'di rnams 'jig rten rang rgyud par bzung nas/ de mchod pa la smod pa ni chos rgyus shin tu chung zhing log rtog 'ba' zhig la rim par chas pa snying rje ba'i gnas yin te/ rgyud las 'di rnams bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs kyi sprul par bshad cing / slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha wa dang / lo tsā ba bai ro tsā na la sogs pas 'di dag rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis mchod cing bsten par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gdul bya 'dul byed dang / gnyen po dang las kyi lha'i khyad par gyis/ 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i dreg byed de dag gis kyang rnal 'byor pa la bar chad mi byed cing / phrin las ched du sgrub pa ni rten 'brel gyi che bar snang ngo / /srung ma 'khrugs te 'di phyir sdug bsngal ba'i/ /than skad bor la mkhas grub brgyud pa ni/ /zam ma chad pa'i lam bzang 'dir zhugs shig /gnas skabs mthar thug don chen 'grub par 'gyur/ /sa ma ya mṛ ti/ rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis 'dun ma rtse mor son/ bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ gying lnga gza' gdong gi gtor chog rje bla mas mdzad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
